name: Cocotte Kirshe
source:
Reinette's younger sister, a high school freshman in the Magic Academy. She runs the Smile magic store on behalf of her sister, when the latter is busy collecting and blending ingredients. Unlike her sister, Cocotte has a cheerful and straightforward personality, and she seems to have more emotions towards Parfait than to her sister's friends. Cocotte's hobby is reading shoujo manga.
